```python
from fractions import Fraction

a, b = Fraction(4, 7), Fraction(1, 5)
lower, upper = sorted((a, b))
scaled_lower, scaled_upper = 77 * lower, 77 * upper

# Enumerate an inclusive integer range covering both rational boundaries.
start = scaled_lower.numerator // scaled_lower.denominator
stop = scaled_upper.numerator // scaled_upper.denominator + 1
values = [
    m for m in range(start, stop + 1)
    if lower < Fraction(m, 77) < upper
]

claimed = Fraction(59, 2)
if values:
    average = Fraction(sum(values), len(values))
    print("Strict bounds on M:", scaled_lower, "< M <", scaled_upper)
    print("Valid integer values:", values)
    print("Count:", len(values))
    print("Sum:", sum(values))
    print("Computed average:", average)
    print("Submitted answer:", claimed)
    print("CHECK PASS" if average == claimed else "CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("No qualifying integer values; the average is undefined.")
    print("CHECK FAIL")
```
